paragraphs.source_en: It was their ignorance of Sahei's intentions that was causing their impatience. Who would take over the huge Inugami Group after the old man's death? How would his enormous fortune be divided? He had never given any indication of his wishes. Then, too, there was a particular reason for their irritation and anxiety: Sahei, for reasons unknown, had never felt any love for his daughters and, what was more, had not an ounce of faith in any of their husbands.
